verdict.rationale: Agora is a developer platform where background automations, such as scheduled or triggered workflows, are a plausible capability, so the axis applies. The pack documents no user-configurable automation, scheduling, or autonomous background job feature. The nearest items are building blocks or adjacent features: real-time voice agents, recording, monitoring alerts, and RESTful APIs. None of these is a documented way to set up automations that run on their own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
